name: Grand Hyatt Manila
positioning: High-rise Grand Hyatt in Bonifacio Global City, Taguig, with a 57th-floor club lounge and city-view rooms
best_for: Travelers who want a high-floor base in Bonifacio Global City
Families or groups wanting a two-bedroom suite

facts.text: Grand Hyatt Manila is at 8th Avenue corner 35th Street in Bonifacio Global City, Taguig City.
Guests with Grand Club access enjoy all-day refreshments and complimentary one-hour use of the boardroom.
All accommodations have a walk-in closet and floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the city skyline.
Grand Suites sit at the corner of each floor, with panoramic city views through floor-to-ceiling windows.
The Two-Bedroom Grand Suite is designed to accommodate families or groups.
The fitness center is open 24 hours, with a personal trainer available on-site.
The Peak combines a grill restaurant, speakeasy, whisky bar and music lounge.
Mitsukoshi Mall is 0.18 miles from the hotel.
The hotel offers 2,281 square meters of event space across multiple floors.

highlights.text: The Grand Club lounge is on the 57th floor, with views over the city.
The Presidential Suite takes up a quarter of an entire floor and has a dining area, a living room and a functioning kitchen.
The Magic Table, on the 66th floor at Penthouse No. 66, is an immersive dining experience created with The Clairvoyants where illusion unfolds course by course.
Rooms and suites feature honeyed wood paneling, maple hardwood floors and gray-white marble bathrooms.
Illume Spa offers treatments blending culture and indigenous traditions with the latest science and technology, in private treatment rooms with ensuite bathrooms.

considerations.text: The heated outdoor pool is on the 6th floor, not on a rooftop.
Manila Ninoy Aquino International Airport is 8 miles away.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
